mapper.select: SELECT wb.id, wb.code, wb.name, wb.description, wb.total_words, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_word_progress p JOIN words w ON w.id = p.word_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND w.book_id = wb.id ) AS learned_words FROM word_books wb ORDER BY wb.id

SELECT wb.id, wb.code, wb.name, wb.description, wb.total_words, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_word_progress p JOIN words w ON w.id = p.word_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND w.book_id = wb.id ) AS learned_words FROM word_books wb WHERE wb.id = #{bookId}
